description: Test file for persistent notification handling in Mattermost server channels app, including unit tests for notification resolution, deletion, and sending logic, especially involving bots and user mentions.

methods.name: TestResolvePersistentNotification
methods.description: Unit tests for resolving persistent notifications, including cases with no posts, mentioned users, post owners, and non-mentioned users.

methods.name: TestDeletePersistentNotification
methods.description: Unit tests for deleting persistent notifications, covering cases with no existing notifications and successful deletion.

methods.name: TestSendPersistentNotifications
methods.description: Test for sending persistent notifications for a post mentioning another user.

methods.name: TestSendPersistentNotificationsBotSender
methods.description: Test for sending notifications when the sender is a bot, including delay simulation.

methods.name: TestSendPersistentNotificationsBotSenderNotInChannel
methods.description: Test for sending notifications when the bot sender is not a channel member, including role elevation to admin.
